driver_decision: The HTTP neon() function only supports BATCHED transactions (no conditional flow), incompatible with the FOR UPDATE claim serialization the frozen core performs. The port uses the same package's WebSocket Client with interactive transactions via a tagged-template adapter inside services/identity/users.ts (verified: begin → FOR UPDATE → rollback live). Single serialized session per instance; pooling lands with T-MIG-002.
